english.title: Unship / unload imported nuclear material with intent to evade a prohibition / restriction
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[unshipped imported nuclear material,]_
(B)_[landed imported nuclear material in a port,]_
(C)_[unloaded imported nuclear material from an aircraft,]_
(D)_[assisted in the unshipping of imported nuclear material,]_
(E)_[assisted in the landing of imported nuclear material at a port,]_
(F)_[assisted in the unloading of imported nuclear material from an aircraft,]_

the importation, landing or unloading of which was prohibited or restricted by **(..SPECIFY THE ENACTMENT..), with intent to evade the prohibition or restriction
english.legislation: Contrary to section 50(2)(a), (4) and (5C) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
unship / land in a port OR
unload from an aircraft OR
assists in such unshipping / landing / unloading
of imported nuclear material
the importation of which is prohibited / restricted
by an enactment
with intent to evade the prohibition / restriction

Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding £20,000 or of three times the value of the goods whichever is the greater.
Indictment: Fourteen years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex
